paragraphs: Here is our housework chart for this Saturday morning. Everyone in my family is busy now.
My father is sweeping the floor in the living room. My mother is cooking breakfast in the kitchen. My brother is washing the dishes.
I am studying in my room because I have a test on Monday. My little sister is not doing housework; she is sleeping on the sofa. She is very young.
Look! My grandpa is reading a newspaper on the chair. My grandma is drawing a picture for me. We are all doing something at the moment.

questions.q: What is the father doing now?
Where is the mother cooking breakfast?
What is the little sister doing?
What is the writer doing in the room?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: What the family is doing now.

paragraphs: It is a busy Saturday morning in my home. Listen! My mother is singing in the kitchen while she cooks. My father is talking to the neighbor at the door.
Look! My sister is dancing in the living room. She is dancing to some music on her phone. My brother is not dancing; he is writing a letter at his desk.
I am helping with the housework. Now I am washing the dishes. The water is running, and I am hearing the sound of the tap.
At the moment, my mother calls me, "Come and take a rest!" I look at her and smile. I am chatting with her for a moment, and then I go back to work.

questions.q: What is the mother doing in the kitchen?
opts: She is singing while she cooks.

questions.q: What does the underlined word "tap" mean?
What is the writer doing now?
What does the mother call the writer to do?

paragraphs: Doing housework is good for teenagers. It helps them learn many life skills.
When you are sweeping the floor, you are exercising your body. When you are washing the dishes, you are practicing careful work. When you are cooking dinner, you are learning about food and safety.
Housework also helps families. If every child often helps with the housework, the home is clean and warm. Parents are not so tired after work.
So next time, do not say, "I am too busy." Look around and see what you can do. You are always growing when you help at home.

questions.q: What does sweeping the floor help you do?
What are you learning when you cook dinner?
What happens if every child helps with the housework?
opts: The home is clean and warm.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest at the end?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: Why housework is good for teenagers.

sa.title: 阅读表达
sa.绑定: 现在进行时 / 家务场景
paragraphs: Busy Sunday
It is Sunday morning in the Li family. Everyone is doing something at home.
Mom is cooking noodles in the kitchen. Dad is washing the car in the yard. My brother is sweeping the floor in the living room.
I am studying English in my room. Listen! Someone is singing outside. It is my little sister. She is dancing slowly in the garden.
At the moment, Dad calls, "Lunch is ready!" We all stop our work and go to the kitchen. What a busy but happy Sunday!

questions.q: What is Mom doing in the kitchen?
What is the little sister doing in the garden?
questions.answer: She is singing and dancing slowly.

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请你用英语写一篇90词左右的短文，介绍你家周末做家务的场景。内容包括：
1. 在什么时间、家人分别在做什么（用现在进行时 be + V-ing）；
2. 你在做什么家务（用 sweep/wash/cook 等动词）；
3. 你的感受是什么。
sample: It is Saturday morning now. My family is busy with the housework.
Look! My father is sweeping the floor in the living room. My mother is cooking breakfast in the kitchen. My brother is washing the dishes after the meal.
I am helping too. Now I am tidying my room and writing my homework. Listen! My little sister is singing happily in the garden.
At the moment, is everyone doing something? Yes! We are all busy but happy. Doing housework together makes our home clean and warm.
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 90 词；2. 用现在进行时描写正在做的事；3. 语句通顺，意思连贯；4. 可适当发挥。
